QUOTE: "`createPost` in `app/actions/remote/post.ts:74` writes the post to the local database before calling the server" and "Rebuilds the post with `props.failed: true`... Saves it to the database"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the post is saved locally before the send and, on failure, is kept in the database with `props.failed: true`.
